coverage.completeness_definition: All original bytes between each selected source title heading and the next title/appendix heading; section records plus title prefix reconstruct those exact spans. This is source-snapshot coverage, not a claim that every operative law is included or current.
coverage.scope_limits: Title 2A also includes criminal/family provisions. Title 34 includes the complete labor/workers-compensation title. Statutes are not court rules or blank court forms. Appendix A is not included in the selected-title index.
